en.assertion: Marriage is the most common reason women give for migrating in Census data.

en.assertion: Census towns are counted as urban areas.

hi.assertion: जनगणना नगरों को नगरीय क्षेत्र माना जाता है।

en.assertion: Many workers move from rural Bihar and Uttar Pradesh to cities in other states.

en.why: Both are true. Push from low farm incomes and pull from urban jobs explain the movement, so R explains A.

en.assertion: Most migration in India is from one state to another.

en.assertion: Slums often grow on the edges of large cities.
en.reason: India's Census is normally held every ten years.
en.why: Both are true, but the Census schedule does not explain slum growth. Slums grow where housing is scarce and costly for migrant workers.
